verdict.summary: Review of marius-patrik/Andromeda PR #300 at 20dff07e601fc252f828fec78525a43ea0eb37d0 is blocked by incomplete authoritative validation and gitlink provenance. The supplied diff otherwise covers the requested six path moves and related documentation and CI routing.

blockingFindings.title: Authoritative validation evidence is missing for the exact head
blockingFindings.details: For PR #300 at base 4739cf8f38191f0879952db04ef4c9a9e9d7ead9 and head 20dff07e601fc252f828fec78525a43ea0eb37d0, the verified state establishes only that the pull request is open at that version. It provides no trusted result for the required `git diff --check` or `git submodule status --recursive` gates, and no verified `bun run ci` result satisfying linked issue #301. Validation claims in the untrusted pull-request body cannot substitute for authoritative exact-head evidence, so approval is blocked pending verified green results.

blockingFindings.title: The moved gitlink pointer contracts lack complete verifiable provenance
blockingFindings.details: The six destination gitlinks are shown as same-content renames in the diff, but the supplied reviewed-file records mark every destination (`packages/darkfactory`, `packages/memory`, `packages/lifequest`, `packages/skyagent`, `packages/singularity`, and `packages/fabrica`) as deleted and provide no recorded commit values. No trusted evidence establishes each child repository's accessibility, exact retained commit, configured-branch relationship, released/default-branch ancestry, or recursive status. This contradictory and incomplete submodule evidence cannot prove issue #301's exact-commit preservation and fresh-clone requirements under the submodule-root policy.

nonBlockingNotes: The supplied diff maps all six legacy managed-repository paths to lowercase direct children of `packages/` and retains the two `data/` paths.
Documentation, CI inventory, suite routing, and fail-closed layout checks were updated consistently with the requested topology.
